selection_rationale: All three certificate-failed folds select self_forcing_finetune before certification.
Uniform teacher recovery admits mixed-sign source environments and therefore cannot satisfy the frozen unanimous-positive-source check.
Horizon-weighted teacher recovery was defined before this stage as the mechanism-specific successor for accumulating exposure error and already passed runtime smoke on two environments.
A single common eight-environment campaign is the minimum valid evidence unit for an eight-environment leave-one-out selector frame; per-environment probe substitution is prohibited.
post_collection_rule: Build the horizon-recovery atlas, replace only the self_forcing_finetune required path in the cumulative affinity, rerun the same selector plan and effect-label index, then rerun the independently frozen collision labels without changing any threshold.
claim_boundary: This stage is diagnostic evidence collection. It is not a model-improvement experiment and cannot by itself establish transfer safety or reduced collision rate.
